projects.review: The Little Prince Among the Stars takes us on a journey through eight tiny planets inspired by the world of The Little Prince. Don't expect big challenges or action-packed gameplay: the real charm lies in wandering through its environments, discovering hidden corners, and soaking up its magical, nostalgic atmosphere. And here's the surprising part: this entire little universe was created in just 16 days with the help of AI. A simple experience with plenty of personality, and one that's definitely worth exploring, even if just for a few minutes.

projects.title: Lost Marbles

gallery.alt: Starting a game in Lost Marbles

projects.review: Lost Marbles throws you into a chaotic race where up to 50 marbles compete to be the last one rolling. Navigate tricky tracks, dodge obstacles, and grab upgrades to stay ahead of the competition. With each round eliminating the slowest racers, things get more intense as you get closer to the finish line. It's a fun, fast-paced experience that's easy to jump into, but winning is a whole different story!

projects.title: The Shipwright

gallery.alt: Playing with colors in The Shipwright

projects.review: The Shipwright is a charming interactive 3D experience that turns shipbuilding into a playful exercise in creativity. Rather than following traditional game mechanics, it invites you to experiment with shapes, colors, materials, and details to design your own unique vessel. Watching your creation take shape in real time makes the process surprisingly satisfying, while the atmospheric ocean setting adds an extra layer of immersion. With its polished visuals and intuitive customization tools, The Shipwright feels like a delightful little digital playground where curiosity and creativity take the helm.

projects.title: Roadster
projects.review: Inspired by Tesla's jaw-dropping Roadster reveal, this playful 3D experience brings the car's gravity-defying stunts straight to your browser. Watch the Roadster race up a massive ramp, flip through the air, and land on its wheels with the help of rocket-like thrusters. A fun little tribute to one of Tesla's wildest demonstrations, recreated in an interactive digital playground.

projects.title: Chinese Garden
projects.review: Chinese Garden is a delightful little escape into a world of tranquility and traditional Chinese beauty. Wander through a charming 3D garden where nature and architecture come together to create a wonderfully peaceful atmosphere. No missions, no ticking clocks, no pressure — just the simple pleasure of exploring a beautiful virtual space at your own pace. It's the kind of experience that reminds you that sometimes, the best thing a digital world can offer is a quiet moment to get lost in.

projects.title: Aquarium Layout Studio

gallery.alt: Playing with customization in the aquarium
Full UI of Aquarium Layout Studio

projects.review: Aquarium Layout Studio is a charming little 3D sandbox that lets you explore the creative side of aquarium design. Experiment with different layouts, arrange your underwater world, and bring it to life with colorful fish swimming around your creation. It's a relaxing mix of creativity and simulation, turning the art of aquascaping into a playful digital experience. Even more impressive? The whole thing was built with AI in just 45 minutes, proving that sometimes a simple idea is all it takes to create something delightful.

projects.title: Learn Arduino
projects.review: Learn Arduino brings the fascinating world of electronics into an interactive 3D learning experience. Instead of getting lost in complicated diagrams and technical manuals, it makes exploring Arduino feel approachable, visual, and fun. It's a refreshing take on hands-on education, showing how interactive 3D environments can turn complex technical concepts into something engaging and enjoyable to discover.

projects.title: Slop New York
projects.review: Slop New York turns Manhattan into a massive 3D playground where the city is yours to explore! Stroll through its iconic streets, hop into a yellow taxi, ride a bike, or take to the skies for a completely different perspective of the Big Apple. From the dazzling lights of Times Square to the towering Empire State Building, there's something exciting about discovering familiar landmarks in this interactive world. Switch between different times of day, experiment with camera angles, or simply cruise around without a destination. It's a delightful mix of urban exploration and open-world freedom, all running right in your browser!

projects.title: PIGMENT GP

desktop.alt: The race is going to start

mobile.alt: The race is going to start

projects.review: Pigment GP is a colorful, fast-paced kart racing game with a wonderfully creative twist: every track's art style changes the way you race! Drift through imaginative circuits, unleash powerful boosts, and battle rivals with paint-inspired power-ups in a world where visuals and physics go hand in hand. With 25 tracks, online multiplayer, and even a track builder to design your own racing challenges, there's plenty of room for experimentation and friendly competition. It's a playful blend of arcade racing and artistic creativity that brings a fresh splash of color to the genre!
